titulo_pagina: Dixi Tower — local control tower for coding agents
descripcion: Live view of the local development agents: what each one is working on, its branch, progress and latest action.
sin_conexion: Lost connection to the dashboard. It retries on its own every few seconds; if it does not come back, start it with: dixi-tower panel
vacio: No agents yet. Press “+ New agent” to launch your first one.
pantalla_vacia: This agent is off. You can turn it back on or delete it; deleting removes its worktree and keeps its branch.
solo_lectura: This dashboard only listens on your machine (127.0.0.1). What you type here goes to the agent's console as is.
escribir: Type an instruction for the agent, or / to see its commands. Enter sends; Shift+Enter adds a line break.
filtro: Search by project, task or id…
elige: Pick an agent from the list.
sugerida: {texto}   ⇥ Tab to use this suggestion from the agent
teclado: Keyboard: with the box empty, ↑ ↓ Enter and Esc go straight to the agent, Tab takes its suggestion and holding the space bar dictates. When the agent needs you, 1, 2 and 3 pick the menu option.
nuevo_nota: A new branch and worktree are created for the project. The agent runs on your subscription and ends with a pull request; it never merges or deploys.
instruccion_ayuda: Required when no board task is picked; optional otherwise.
forzar: Launch even if the project is over its in-review limit
error_lanzar: The agent could not be launched.
error_reanudar: The operation could not be completed.
autonomia_ayuda: Supervised: asks before editing and before running anything outside its allowed list. Balanced: edits without asking and checks in for commands outside the list. Autonomous: decides on its own and asks as little as possible. At every level it never merges, deploys or reads secrets.
subagentes_cuantos: Maximum subagents open at a time (1 to 20)
limites_ayuda: When your account usage reaches the given percentage, the agent stops working and tells you. 0 means no limit. Usage is account-wide: every agent shares it.
tope_alcanzado: This agent stopped at its usage limit: {motivo}. Raise the limit in Settings to let it continue.
ajustes_nota: Limits and subagents apply right away. Engine and autonomy apply the next time you turn this agent on.
config_nota: Values every new agent starts with. Existing agents keep their own; change those in their Settings.
error_config: The settings could not be saved.
uso_pendiente: shown once Codex reports it in its footer
uso_sin_control: limits are not enforced with this engine
codex_nota: With Codex: its sandbox protects .git, so in supervised and balanced it asks you to approve each commit, and in autonomous an automatic reviewer approves it. The first time in each repository it asks to trust the folder. Usage is shown but limits cannot be enforced, and the subagent cap applies when the agent is turned on.
tope_revision_ayuda: Only applies to projects with tasks/TASKS.md: no new agent is launched if the project has more tasks in review than this number, unless you force it at launch. 0 turns it off.
dictado_permiso: The browser is not allowed to use the microphone. Enable it for this site and try again.
dictado_aviso: Hold to dictate. Uses your browser's speech recognition: in Chrome the audio is transcribed on Google's servers.
ruta_aviso: Insert the path of a file or folder on your computer into your message
ruta_titulo: Pick a file or a folder
ruta_nota: Its path is inserted into your message so the agent knows where it is. Hidden files are not shown.
adjuntos_ayuda: Attachments: drag or paste files and images here; a copy is saved and its path inserted. For the real path of a file or folder, use “Path”.
adjunto_grande: “{nombre}” is larger than 25 MB: use “Path” to point to it instead of copying it.
adjunto_carpeta: A web page cannot know the path of a folder dropped on it. Pick it here and its path will be inserted.
carpeta_modo_ninguna: None: ask for the repository path on every agent
carpeta_ayuda: It is yours: it is saved in your configuration (config.json) and affects nobody else. Applied when you press Save, no restart needed. Existing agents do not change.
carpeta_sugerida: Not saved yet: this path is only a suggestion. Select the option and press Save to keep it.
aviso_carpeta_texto: You have not saved one yet and {carpeta} does not exist, so no project is listed.
carpeta_no_existe: That folder does not exist or cannot be read: no project will be listed.
carpeta_falta: Type the folder path or pick another option.
tablero_ayuda: Optional, with http:// or https://. If you set it, the panel shows a link to the board at the bottom left.
n_ruta_ayuda: Absolute path of a git repository's root (the folder that contains .git).
n_sin_carpeta: There is no projects folder: enter the repository path. You can set one in Settings › Projects.
ruta_nota_carpeta: Only folders are shown, without hidden ones. “Use this folder” copies it into the form.
